subject: Bespoke bars and entertaining furniture
hook: Will a bar top cope with spills, wet glasses and the odd dropped bottle opener?
fb:
With party season getting going, we have been asked a few times: will a bar top actually cope with spills and wet glasses?

With sensible care, yes. Our tops are engineered board with a hard-wearing surface finish, and the edges are sealed with ABS edging. Wipe spills up promptly, especially around edges and joints, and use coasters for wet or hot glasses. If fingerprints bother you, matt and super matt finishes hide them better than gloss.

As the Black Friday adverts start, it is worth remembering that something built for your space and looked after properly will outlast most sale bargains. Ask us anything here:

gbp:
Will a bar top cope with spills and wet glasses?

With sensible care, yes. SUPERIO bar tops, sideboards and drinks cabinets are made from engineered board with a hard-wearing surface finish, and every visible edge is sealed with ABS edging, with thicker edging on room-facing edges that take knocks.

A few simple habits keep them looking good:
- Wipe up spills promptly, especially near edges and joints
- Use coasters for wet, cold or hot glasses
- Clean with a soft, damp cloth rather than abrasive products
- Choose matt or super matt if fingerprints bother you, as they hide them better than gloss

Everything is made in our own workshop in Hanley and installed by our own team across Cheadle and the surrounding area. If you are planning a home bar or entertaining space, book a free, no-obligation design consultation and we will talk you through the finishes in person.
